description: Source code for string utilities including variable interpolation, string splitting, UTF-8 handling, and string escaping, used within the Wesnoth project.

classes.name: string_map_variable_set
classes.description: A variable_set implementation that retrieves variables from a string_map.

classes.name: utf8_iterator
classes.description: An iterator for traversing UTF-8 encoded strings.

methods.name: do_interpolation
methods.description: Performs variable interpolation within a string based on a variable_set.

methods.name: interpolate_variables_into_string
methods.description: Interpolates variables into a string using either a string_map or variable_set.

methods.name: escape
methods.description: Escapes special characters in a string with backslashes.

methods.name: unescape
methods.description: Removes backslash escape characters from a string.

methods.name: split
methods.description: Splits a string into a vector of substrings based on a delimiter.

methods.name: quoted_split
methods.description: Splits a string by a delimiter, ignoring delimiters inside quotes.

methods.name: parse_range
methods.description: Parses a string representing a range (e.g., '1-5') into a pair of integers.

methods.name: byte_size_from_utf8_first
methods.description: Determines the number of bytes in a UTF-8 character based on its first byte.

methods.name: wstring_to_string
methods.description: Converts a wide string to a UTF-8 encoded string.

methods.name: string_to_wstring
methods.description: Converts a UTF-8 string to a wide string.

methods.name: utf8_string_to_ucs2_string
methods.description: Converts a UTF-8 string to UCS2 encoding.

methods.name: ucs2_string_to_utf8_string
methods.description: Converts a UCS2 string to UTF-8 encoding.

methods.name: capitalize
methods.description: Converts the first character of a UTF-8 string to uppercase.

methods.name: uppercase
methods.description: Converts a UTF-8 string to uppercase.

methods.name: lowercase
methods.description: Converts a UTF-8 string to lowercase.

methods.name: vgettext
methods.description: Retrieves a localized string and performs variable interpolation.
